| # Failure detection possibilities {#failure-detection-possibilities-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                                                                                                                  |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

In order to ensure the safety integrity, the RCs are equipped with various diagnostic methods that [monitor](cyclic-monitoring-checks.html){.topiclink} the hardware (see [Self-monitoring](ecu-self-monitoring.html){.topiclink}) and the execution of the software (see [Diagnostic System Management](diagnosticsystemmanagement.html){.topiclink}). These diagnostic methods as well as the corresponding failure reactions are summarized in the following table.

In case of a diagnostic function detecting a safety-related failure ([Diagnostic Fault Check](diagnostic-fault-check.html){.topiclink}) the failure will be saved (see [Diagnostic Fault Event Storage](diagnostic-fault-event-storage.html){.topiclink} [Data storage in internal data flash](datastorageininternaldataflash.html){.topiclink}) and handled according to the table below.

Refer [Safety function and safe state](safetyfunctionandsafestate.html){.topiclink} for details on the safety functions provided by the RCs and the related considerations to be observed e.g., if outputs are not used.

 

 

 

+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------+

| Power-on test                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |

| Shut-OFF capability of the watchdog                                                                                             | Disabling of the power outputs                     | Every time at power-on                                             | \-                                       |

|                                                                                                                                 |                                                    |                                                                    |                                          |

|                                                                                                                                 |                                                    |                                                                    |                                          |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------+
| CRC check of each block in the DFlash                                                                                           | Initializing the RAM Mirror with 0xFF              | Every time at power-on                                             | \-                                       |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------+
